items.title: Corporate Business Template
items.description: A lightweight, modern web template designed to help corporate services reach more clients efficiently.
items.detailDescription: This template offers a sleek, professional layout featuring a hero image slider, service highlights, key metrics counters, client logo showcases, and clear call-to-action sections to effectively convert visitors into leads.
features: Lightweight and modern responsive design
Hero slider section with call-to-action buttons
Dedicated services breakdown cards
Key metrics and achievements counters
Multilingual support layout with contact integration

items.title: Administrative & Sales Dashboard Template
items.description: A modern, responsive administrative dashboard designed for tracking contracts, payments, seller performance, and overdue balances.
items.detailDescription: This template is an intuitive management dashboard template tailored for businesses that handle sales, contracts, and payment tracking across multiple channels. It features real-time overview metrics for active, pending, and canceled contracts, clear financial debt summaries, payment method breakdowns (Zelle, PayPal, Binance, Cash, etc.), and downloadable reports grouped by seller.
features: Real-time contract status tracking (Active, Pending Dispatch, Canceled, Finished)
Comprehensive balance summary (Total Debt, Overdue Debt, Pending Balance, Paid Total)
Multi-channel payment breakdown (Zelle, PayPal, Binance, Mobile Payment, Cash)
Downloadable sales and debt reports grouped by seller
Clean, mobile-optimized responsive layout with tabbed navigation

items.title: Women's Fashion & Beauty Store Template
items.description: An elegant and modern e-commerce web template designed for women's fashion, accessories, and beauty products.
items.detailDescription: Complete online store template featuring a refined aesthetic tailored for fashion and beauty brands. It includes structured product categories (dresses, blouses, skirts, coats, jewelry, makeup, skincare, and fragrances), a featured catalog layout, customer testimonial sections, promotional banners with countdown timers, and integrated search and navigation features.
features: Clean, modern layout optimized for fashion and skincare products
Comprehensive category navigation including clothing, accessories, and cosmetics
Featured catalog sections with price displays and quick-buy buttons
Promotional offer banner with integrated countdown timer
Built-in customer review section and social media links

items.title: Equestrian Equipment & Apparel
items.description: A refined, modern e-commerce template designed specifically for equestrian gear, riding apparel, and tack supplies.
items.detailDescription: An elegant and robust e-commerce template tailored for equestrian brands, horse tack shops, and riding apparel retailers. Featuring clean typography, curated product showcases, integrated promotional banners with countdown timers, customer contact forms, and bilingual-ready header navigation, this design provides a complete and professional shopping experience for horse enthusiasts and riders.
features: Product catalog showcasing saddles, boots, apparel, helmets, and care accessories
Promotional banner with dynamic countdown timer for special offers and sales
Newsletter subscription bar offering promotional discount codes
Customer inquiry form tailored for rider discipline and horse equipment needs
Favorites list and navigation support for multi-language toggle
